rules.damage: Owner validated, positive amount, atomic, zero floor.
rules.broken_state: durability=0 may set instance metadata broken=true; final combat and equipment effects remain owned by their subsystems.
rules.repair: Requires projected maximum_durability, positive amount, atomic, capped at maximum.
rules.repair_cleanup: A successful positive repair removes broken metadata.
rules.missing_projection: Fail closed; do not create durability or maximum values.
rules.destruction: Durability reaching zero does not destroy the item unless separately proven.
